title: The `available` cap cannot do what its comment says it does; carries the merged DEDUP-25-09 residual and P-04's DoS tail
severityNote: QA. Impact today: NONE (provably non-binding). Confidence: high that the claim is false; not currently exploitable.
note:
[phoenix-nft-staking-25] NEW QA @5015f1b (DEDUP-25-08). The comment at :647-655 retains the cap 'only so an unforeseen shortfall degrades into a smaller refund rather than a revert.' It cannot serve that purpose: `available` is an ABSOLUTE balanceOf and equals P + (credited - C) + D, so a shortfall in the caller's own credit does not make it bind until P AND this batch's donations D have already been consumed in full. IN EXACTLY THE SCENARIO THE COMMENT NAMES, THE SHORTFALL IS SILENTLY ABSORBED BY THE POT INSTEAD OF DEGRADING THE REFUND. A cap doing what the prose claims would have to be caller-scoped, and no such quantity is tracked after :581. Provably non-binding today: budget <= credited (:580 min) and available = P + (credited - C) + D >= credited - C >= budget, so refund == budget on every constructible path - dead code that reads as a safety net.

*** MERGED RESIDUAL FROM THE SUPPRESSED DEDUP-25-09 (sanitizer §2 - preserved, NOT dropped): *** `budget` is a ONE-SHOT MEASUREMENT PINNED ONCE AT :581 AND NEVER RE-VALIDATED, so ANY post-:581 erosion of this contract's payment-token holdings is charged to P, silently. This needs NO weird token - P-03 ranks a negative-rebase prime token as an independent mechanism. *** P-04's DoS TAIL RIDES HERE TOO: *** once such erosion exceeds P + D, the step-9/10 swap turns a silent pot shrink into a batchMint REVERT ON THE PAYOUT LEG. The C4 known-invalid rule invalidated DEDUP-25-09's WEIRD-TOKEN EXPLOIT NARRATIVE, not this UNRECONCILED-MEASUREMENT RESIDUAL. Filed because the residual is the same balanceOf conflation story-029 was written to eliminate, sitting at the one site the file elsewhere explicitly forbids absolute reads (:585-605), with a comment that would mislead the next author into believing a protection exists. RECOMMENDATION: delete the cap and let an impossible shortfall revert honestly, or track a caller-scoped quantity and cap on that.
